name: Zemlja
source:
The main character, Noboru, moves to a city with his parents. On his first day at school he overhears two girls arguing on the school rooftop. Intrigued, he wants to know the reason for their dispute.

[Taken from [url=https://anivisual.net/forum/54-5041-1]Anivisual.net[/url]]
translation:
主角登和父母搬到了一座城市。上学第一天，他无意中听到两个女孩在学校屋顶上吵架。出于好奇，他想知道他们争执的原因。

[摘自[url=https://anivisual.net/forum/54-5041-1]Anivisual.net[/url]]
